name: formify-construction
description: Formify for Construction and Renovation (EU) — Formify Core plus the documents a contractor signs: quotes, works contracts with the consumer withdrawal form, variation orders, handover records, subcontracts and payment confirmations. Asks which EU country applies and follows its rules. Includes the full Core skill set — do not install Formify Core as well.

interface.longDescription: Formify for Construction and Renovation includes everything in Formify Core, plus the documents a contractor signs with clients and subcontractors: quotes, works contracts with the consumer withdrawal information and form, variation orders, handover records, warranty notes, subcontracts and payment confirmations. It asks which EU country applies, follows that country's rules and prepares the document in the local language, ready to sign. Install this alone — do not also install Formify Core, or you will get duplicate skills and two Formify connections.
defaultPrompt: Draft a renovation contract with the 14-day withdrawal form for a private client
Prepare a subcontract and a variation order for a bathroom renovation
Send the quote for signature and tell me who has signed
